name: @map-harness/spatial-viz
description: Spatial visualization workbench contracts: the versioned StyleSpec/LegendSpec pair (classification breaks always computed from frozen data, manual breaks requiring an exact statistic source), the deterministic timezone-aware time-axis state machine, and the shared selection-filter/attribute/export vocabulary that keeps layer, legend, table, chart, and export on one style/data/time revision. A pure library the tools and the browser workbench consume — no host row.
